prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a production transparent facial-parts atlas for a new standing Live2D character, NOT a complete portrait.
Input image 1 is the approved faceless standing body; preserve its identity/style when designing parts. Input image 2 is the authoritative close-up face style reference. Input image 3 is the user's matching 3D character reference. Do not output these whole figures or backgrounds.
Primary request: create ONE transparent square atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal cells, each part completely inside its cell with ample clear padding, no grid lines or labels. Crisp professional anime game linework matching the reference character Phoenix Reffaella: golden-orange honey irises with fine rings and bright small highlights, elegant slightly drooping almond eyes, dark desaturated purple-black thick upper eyelashes with tapered outer flicks, subtle thin lower rim, slender pale taupe brows and tiny restrained mouth marks. The previous rig looked like a round baby-faced doll: avoid oversized circular eyes, excessive rounded sparkle pupils, heavy blush, childish eyebrows, or a generic cute face.
Cell order, left-to-right:
ROW 1: viewer-left open eye frame including white sclera and upper/lower lashes but NO iris/pupil; viewer-right open eye frame including white sclera and lashes but NO iris/pupil; isolated viewer-left golden iris/pupil/highlight disc; isolated viewer-right golden iris/pupil/highlight disc.
ROW 2: viewer-left fully closed resting eyelash line; viewer-right fully closed resting eyelash line; viewer-left eyebrow; viewer-right eyebrow.
ROW 3: tiny neutral closed mouth line; subtle closed gentle-smile line; subtle worried closed mouth line; open speaking mouth interior with dark warm cavity, small pale upper teeth and muted pink tongue, NO surrounding skin.
ROW 4: small surprised oval open mouth interior; slightly wider happy open mouth interior; subtle pair of pale pink cheek hatch accents as one small sprite; leave the last cell empty and fully transparent.
Style/constraints: all sprites are isolated on genuine alpha transparency. No skin rectangles, no head, no hair, no nose, no surrounding face, no text, no watermark, no paper, no checkerboard, no borders, no drop shadows. Eye frames and irises are SEPARATE sprites so eyes can gaze and blink independently. Open eye frames have clean blank white sclera with no colored iris or dark pupil at all. Left and right eyelash orientations mirror naturally for a straight-on face. The mouth marks must remain small and restrained like the actual reference. Use the reference's exact color family and linework, not a new character design.
reference_roles: approved faceless standing base: pose/style invariant
official face crop: identity/eye linework reference
user supplied 3D preview: matching costume and face proportion reference
publication: Prompt text only; input/output artwork and reference-derived frames remain private.
